entities.name: Henry Adefope
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Henry Edmund Olufemi Adefope was a Nigerian Army major general who served as Minister of Foreign Affairs and as a member of the International Olympic Committee from 1985 to 2006 and an honorary member of the International Olympic Committee since 2007.
